text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Rice
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn....

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, are you alright? 
You seem a bit worn out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Rice is totally fine! 
More importantly, Rob Roy-san, what about 
you—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing major for me either. 
It's just... this week—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"D-Does anyone have any suggestions 
for next month's library committee 
initiatives...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... In that case! 
What if we try doing something that worked 
well 
from one of our past initiatives 
again...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I tried my best to keep things moving, 
but I just kept spinning my wheels...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Pushing yourself to talk is really hard, 
isn't it? 
Lots of people came up to talk to Rice, 
too, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Is this okay? If they talk to Rice, 
she might bring them bad luck and cause 
trouble...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you were emotionally drained, 
just like me, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, how about this? Why 
don't we 
spend today quietly in the dorms and 
recharge our batteries?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-Yeah! Then Rice— 
maybe Rice will spend the whole day 
reading picture books...♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how lovely! 
Please allow me to join you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, but before that—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Waaah... It smells so wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Reading with a piping-hot mug of cocoa in 
hand— 
this truly is a moment of pure bliss, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ehehe... Rice thinks 
she's already grinning from ear to ear.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... Um, in that case, 
would you mind if I made one more 
suggestion?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's a place 
I'd really love to go with you, Rice-san—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The sun is sparkling so brightly... and 
it's so quiet. 
If we read our picture books here—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it feels like we can really focus. 
So today, let's read here to our hearts' 
content—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Phew, this is so relaxing... 
Truly an ideal day off—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? When did it get so late?! 
Wait, where is Rice-san—?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(What should I do? If I got so absorbed in 
my reading 
that I ended up boring Rice-san to tears, 
then—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Thank goodness... Rice-san looks like 
she's having fun too—)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Wait, is that the time—?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we got totally lost in our reading, 
didn't we? 
Um, Rice-san. Today—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was so much fun♪ 
Thank you, Rob Roy-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning after the holiday. 
In the academy hallway, I spotted a 
high-spirited 
Zenno Rob Roy and Rice Shower.
